comment: This class is the best FYS by far. So easy, just some papers and video lectures, but he gives everyone A's just for turning in work. He makes the class super interesting and just wants to get people talking. You definitely don't need to be an art person at all to take this class, super interesting and easy A for sure.

mr. josafath is such an amazing professor. He assigns short video lectures for homework and they're actually hilarious. He edits the videos in such a fun way and I'm actually always excited to watch them. He's clearly super passionate about his work, and he makes class discussion interesting and thought-provoking. take this class bc he's a total g

Prof. Reynoso is literally the most amazing prof ever, his FYS, 'Artist as Provocatuer' was my favorite class I've taken at UR and he gives very limited reading, instead providing fun and engaging video lectures he puts together himself. The discussions in class are always interesting and usually pretty fun. Really just overall amazing, no complain
This class is heavy on discussion and class participation. He is very caring and will be understanding of your circumstances. As long as you watch the videos and engage in conversation you will pass.

Joe is one of the most amazing professors I have ever had. He is tough only because he expects a lot from his students because there is a lot to do, but he is not unreasonable. I have never enjoyed a class so much. It's a lot of work, but if you are willing to put in the work, he'll know.

Heads up: Stagecraft requires you to work 3 hours a week in the Set Shop, attend performances, and participate in striking the sets of Department performances. Josefath said that simply doing what he asks in projects "is a B." He does a poor job at making it clear what he wants. The projects are also very time consuming, as you can imagine.
